name: Essex County Express
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current Agenda #.
[cultist]: -1. If you fail and it is your turn, lose all remaining actions and end your turn immediately.
[tablet]: -2. Add 1 doom token to the nearest Cultist enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose and discard a card from your hand.
back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current Agenda #. 
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and it is your turn, lose all remaining actions and end your turn immediately.
[tablet]: -4. Add 1 doom token to each Cultist enemy in play.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose and discard a card from your hand for each point you failed by.

flavor: As the train to Dunwich comes to a jarring stop, you look out the window behind you and see an immense tear in the sky, like a rip in a piece of cloth. Several of the rearmost train cars are pulled backwards, and there is a dreadful metallic crunch as they are detached. The train cars topple upwards and into the rift in the sky. Nearby passengers are panicking, others are cowering in their seats, and one elderly man has fainted in fear.
name: A Tear in Reality
back_flavor: The rearmost car of the train detaches as it is pulled backwards. To your horror, it rises off the tracks and is consumed by the gate above you.
back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.

flavor: The tear grows larger, and you can feel the rearmost car of the train shaking as it is pulled backwards. The situation threatens to erupt into chaos as more passengers realize the danger they are in. Some passengers are looking for places to hide, while others are running about the compartments in terror.
name: The Maw Widens
back_flavor: The next train car is ripped backwards with violent force. A middle-aged man hangs from his fingertips as the car flies unhindered toward the rift. In moments, the car is consumed whole, and the man lets go rather than be pulled into the void. He starts to fall, but is caught by the rift's force and pulled inside it anyway.
back_text:
Remove the leftmost location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at that location is defeated. Each enemy and asset at that location is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.

flavor: The pull of the rift in the sky seems to grow stronger, and the entire train begins to roll backwards along the tracks. The rearmost cars of the train begin to rattle, the force of the rift threatening to detach them. You must get out of these cars as fast as you can!
name: Rolling Backwards
back_flavor: Two of the train cars closest to the gate are severed from the rest of the train by a sheet of impossibly hot steam, which slices through metal like a knife through butter. The cars are sucked upwards and fly into the gate. Something above the train lets out a terrible screech, though to your ears it is like the shrill sound of a broken steam pipe.
back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.

flavor: The gate crackles with power as its strength increases. Dirt and rocks from the edge of the bridge behind you are torn from the ground and trees are uprooted, pulled in by the gate. One younger passenger smashes the window of your car and shouts, “We gotta get outta here!” He leaps out of the window, but before he lands in the river below, he is snatched in the talons of a swift flying creature, and carried out of sight. A trail of steam is left in the creature’s wake.
name: Drawn In
back_flavor: The two rearmost train cars begin to melt as they are filled with superheated steam. The metal warps, and the passengers inside scream in agony. The cars are ripped from the train tracks along with rail slats and chunks of the bridge behind you.
back_text:
Remove each of the two leftmost locations from the game (or place it in the victory display if either one has Victory X and no clues on it). Each investigator at those locations is defeated. Each enemy and asset at those locations is discarded.
Discard all clues controlled by the investigators.

flavor: The rift in the sky twists and shakes, completely distorted. Its size is now massive, its shape warping and shifting, as if it is about to explode.
name: Out of Time
back_flavor: The entire bridge cracks under the pressure of the gate, and breaks apart. Instead of plummeting into the river, the remaining train cars are pulled into the sky, toward the rift. You hang on for dear life and scream in horror as you are pulled into the gate. Then, everything goes black.
back_text: Each investigator is immediately defeated and takes 1 mental trauma. (→R2)

flavor: O trem parou em uma ponte bem acima do Rio Miskatonic - vocês talvez consigam sobreviver à queda, mas não gostam de suas chances. A melhor aposta seria chegar à locomotiva o mais rápido possível e colocar o trem em movimento mais uma vez.
name: Corram!
text: Objetivo - Se um investigador entrar na Locomotiva, avance imediatamente.
back_text:
O investigador que entrar na Locomotiva deve ler o seguinte (em voz alta):

Um vagão-reboque cheio de carvão bloqueia o caminho até a locomotiva. Engolindo o medo, você sai pela janela mais próxima e escala para o teto do trem, avançando pelo vagão-reboque. O trem faz um movimento constante para trás, o que torna difícil manter-se em pé. Conforme você se aproxima, uma criatura alada desce do céu, seu corpo composto por vapor quente e sibilante.

Você deve decidir (escolha um):
- [action] Teste [agility] (3) para tentar desviar da criatura. Se você falhar, acaba saltando longe demais e por pouco se agarra à lateral do trem, segurando-se por sua vida. Embora consiga se levantar, a experiência é aterrorizante. Você sofre 1 trauma mental.
- [action] Teste [combat] (3) para tentar resistir ao calor extremo da criatura. Se você falhar, a criatura voa através de você e o calor lhe queima. Você sofre 1 trauma físico.

flavor: Vocês conseguiram chegar à locomotiva, mas agora precisam ligar o motor novamente, para que consigam se afastar da força de tração do portal!
name: Liguem os Motores!
text: Objetivo - Se não houver pistas em Locomotiva, avance imediatamente.
back_flavor: O motor ruge de volta à vida e começa a girar as rodas. Vocês colocam carvão na fornalha do motor e ficam aliviados ao ver que o trem está andando para frente mais uma vez.

flavor: O que aconteceu no outro lado?
name: Através do Espaço e do Tempo
text: Revelação – Descarte as 3 cartas do topo do seu baralho.

name: Passageiro Desamparado
text: Ímpeto. Revelação - Coloque Passageiro Desamparado em jogo no local à sua esquerda (ou em seu local, se não for possível). [action] Negociata. Assuma o controle de Passageiro Desamparado. Forçado - Se Passageiro Desamparado sair de jogo: Cada investigador sofre 1 de horror.

name: Garras de Vapor
text: Revelação – Teste [willpower] (3). Se você falhar, sofra 2 de dano e você não pode se mover deste local nesta rodada. O dano deste efeito deve ser atribuído aos seus ativos primeiro, se possível.

flavor: Seu carro do trem começa a estremecer e chacoalhar violentamente pelos trilhos, jogando-os no chão.
name: Trilhos Quebrados
text: Revelação – Cada investigador no seu local perde 1 ação. Cada investigador no seu local com 4 ou mais de dano também deve descartar um ativo que controla.

name: Horror Agarrador
text: Caçador. Enquanto você estiver engajado com Horror Agarrador, você não pode se mover.

flavor: A criatura irrompe de baixo de um dos assentos, aumentando em massa e volume sem parar, ameaçando envolver o compartimento inteiro.
name: Monstruosidade Emergente
text: Surgir – O local à sua direita (ou o seu local, se não houver local à sua direita). Monstruosidade Emergente entra em jogo esgotada.
